_meta.purpose: Maps each sender domain in the Smartlead fleet to its infrastructure batch (registrar + mailbox provider + expected DNS nameserver provider). Used by the email-deliverability-audit skill to enrich reports with per-batch context (e.g. flag when a batch's domains have NS that don't match its expected provider).
_meta.update_pattern: When adding a new batch, append to `batches` and add the domains to `domain_batches.csv`. When migrating a batch to new NS, update `expected_ns` here and re-run the audit to confirm fleet matches.
classification_rules: When classifying a new domain to a batch, look for the consistent brand name within the domain itself — that usually identifies the company. Examples: '*navreo*' = Navreo, '*amplifyy*' / '*amplify*' = Amplifyy, '*bytedance*' / '*seed*' = ByteDance (Sean Zhou).
Generic-themed domains (no brand keyword, e.g. 'bridgeandscale.info', 'flowstrategy.org', 'reachalign.net') paired with from_name='Jane Smithson' typically belong to Client Backups.

Exception: when a domain contains both a brand keyword AND the Jane Smithson persona (e.g. 'launchwithnavreo.*' + Jane Smithson), do NOT auto-classify as Client Backups — surface to user; might be brand owner using Jane as a backup persona.
Naming convention for new batches: {company}-{persona}-{provider}, all lowercase, hyphenated.
